zh: 边长 s 可行当且仅当存在连续 s 栋楼，它们的最低高度至少为 s；s 越大条件越难满足，可行性单调。
对边长二分：判断某个 k 是否可行，只需看所有长度为 k 的窗口里，是否有窗口的最小值 ≥ k，这可以用单调队列求滑动窗口最小值。
二分范围 [0, min(n, max h)]；check(k) 用单调递增的下标队列扫描，队头过期就弹出、队尾不小于当前高度就弹出，窗口满 k 且队头高度 ≥ k 即返回可行；取最大可行 k，输出 k²（用 64 位）。
en: Side s is feasible exactly when some s consecutive buildings all have height at least s; a larger s only makes this harder, so feasibility is monotone.
Binary search on the side length: to check a given k, ask whether some window of length k has minimum ≥ k, which a monotonic deque computes as a sliding-window minimum.

Search k in [0, min(n, max h)]; check(k) scans with a deque of indices of increasing heights, popping expired indices from the front and indices with height ≥ the current one from the back, and returns true once a full window of size k has front height ≥ k; print the largest feasible k squared (as a 64-bit value).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Whether a square of side k fits can be decided with a sliding-window minimum: is there a window of width k whose lowest building is ≥ k? Feasibility is monotone in k, so binary search the largest side and square it.

## Correctness

Any square of side k must rest on at least k consecutive buildings, each of height ≥ k; conversely, a window satisfying this condition really does hold a k×k square. So the window test is necessary and sufficient. Increasing k only makes the condition harder, so the largest k can be binary searched.

## Complexity

Each check takes O(n), the binary search takes O(log min(n, max(h))) rounds, and space is O(n).
